en.title: Minimum Cost to Clear All Variant B Items With a Fixed-Size Window
en.description:
products is a 0/1 array. Each time, you must choose exactly k consecutive positions, pay the current number of 1s in that window, and then change one 1 in the window to 0. Find the minimum total cost to clear all 1s; if everything is already 0, no operation is needed.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n k and the second line contains products. The original statement specifies binary values and 1≤k≤n, with no upper bound on n; this site adds 1≤n≤200000.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 6, 3 and 0. In the first example you must choose all three positions every time, paying 3, 2 and 1 in turn.
hints: Let T be the total number of 1s, and use a sliding window to find the minimum number q of 1s in any initial window of length k; return T+q(q−1)/2.
